meta.description: v2 FROZEN HOLDOUT. Same phenomena and scoring as v0 + v1_extra, built from deliberately new lexical material (verbs, prepositions and nouns absent from data/generated/*.valid.jsonl and from v0/v1). Exists because v0/v1 have been scored by 20+ models and used for ship decisions, which makes them dev sets: their absolute numbers are optimistic even though they never leaked. RULES: score each candidate on this suite ONCE, never iterate against it, never generate training data from it. See DATA_V2_DISTILL_PLAN.md.
meta.scoring: Identical to v0/v1 — run with scripts/run_baseline_eval.py. correction: expect_ok items must get 'OK'; error items must produce a FIX: line matching require_all/require_any and no forbid_any. cloze: answer must contain the expected token. Always report with --app-guard.
meta.verified: 0 exact and 0 near-duplicate (Jaccard>=0.6) overlaps against both data/generated/*.valid.jsonl and v0/v1, checked 2026-07-28. validate_data.py globs data/eval/*.json, so this file now also auto-protects itself from future synthetic generation.
meta.revisions: Revised ONCE on 2026-07-28, before any model result was recorded, after a shakedown run surfaced three items where a correct answer could fail: dawo-z1 (referent 'die Prüfung' made 'an sie' as valid as 'daran' — swapped to a neuter referent where only the da-compound is grammatical), artikel-e2 ('der Fenster' admitted both 'das Fenster' and plural 'die Fenster' — swapped to 'Buch', which has no such plural reading), relpron-o1 ('feiert Jubiläum' vs 'feiert sein Jubiläum' is a genuine usage split, not an error — replaced). FROZEN from this point.
